_meta.description: PC-side code map of the Mercenaries 2 PgFX particle/effect subsystem and the shadow subsystem, reversed from the unpacked SecuROM image decomp via a 7-agent fan-out. Companion docs: docs/reverse_engineer/particle_fx_code_map.md, docs/reverse_engineer/shadow_code_map.md.
_meta.method: Anchored on retail-exe strings (.sho shader names, reflection class descriptors, the PC source path PgLtiRendererShadowPc.cpp, cvar names) + callgraph/vtable analysis. Xbox PDB names (docs/mercs2-pdb-analysis/rendering-shaders.md) bound to PC addresses by semantics.
_meta.caveat: The retail PC build STRIPS the PgFX/PgScene profiler-marker strings, and the per-frame render/emit/simulate passes are vtable-dispatched (no static callers). Those functions are recorded with their vtable address+slot and marked confirm-live (x32dbg); they are not guessed. Static anchors (reflection registration, binary-format parsers, shader registry, shadow-RT setup, cvars) are high/med confidence.

Inside the gate it iterates renderables (thunk_FUN_024bbd20(4,...) = phase-4 shadow list), skips flagged ones (renderable+0x12&1), distance-classifies each caster via FUN_00858150 and frustum-culls via FUN_00857c00, then enqueues shadow-pass packets into the DAT_018c5620 command arrays. Best static candidate for CollectShadowCasters.
